body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-17 08:03Z, my own miss). A FRESH worktree, such as a train carry worktree, has no ui/node_modules. The full gate's runner then fails before any stage with ENOENT ui/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc (TRAIN-4 test-9979f1c8). Before LAUNCH NOW in any worktree that was newly created, schedule `npm ci` in its ui/ as its own command, and check that it's present in the pre-flight (ui/node_modules/typescript exists). The npm ci must happen in an allowed window, not during the other project's gate.
